title: What is Stigma Attributed to? A Theory-Grounded, Expert-Annotated Interview Corpus for Demystifying Mental-Health Stigma

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking LLMs (e.g., GPT-4o, Llama 3, Mistral) and RoBERTa on an 8-way classification task to detect and categorize mental-health stigma (e.g., responsibility, fear, social distance, anger) from expert-annotated human-chatbot interview transcripts based on psychological attribution theory.
